name: dsr-trustweek-demo
//: Root shim. The real app lives in src/. v0's preview panel and Publish both operate from the repo root, so this file exists to give them a dev/build script to find. Without it, nothing listens on :3000 and the preview panel stays blank.

scripts.dev: cd src && (test -d node_modules || npm ci) && npm run dev
scripts.build: cd src && (test -d node_modules || npm ci) && npm run build
